bridge-type.label: BMW CarData Account
bridge-type.description: Access to the vehicles of a BMW Group customer account via BMW CarData

parameter-group.name: broker
parameter-group.label: Local Broker
parameter-group.description: Local MQTT broker the bmw-mqtt-bridge publishes the CarData stream to, or the binding mirrors it to

parameter-group.name: rest
parameter-group.label: API Requests
parameter-group.description: BMW allows 50 API requests per account and day

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Client ID
parameter.description: The client ID created in the BMW CarData section of the MyBMW / MINI customer portal. The client needs the subscriptions "CarData API" and "CarData Streaming".

parameter.name: streaming
parameter.label: Streaming
parameter.description: Receive vehicle data pushed by the CarData streaming service. The data selected for the stream in the customer portal is updated as soon as the vehicle reports it.

parameter.name: streamMode
parameter.label: Stream Mode
parameter.description: Connect to the BMW streaming service directly, or receive the stream from a local MQTT broker the bmw-mqtt-bridge publishes to. BMW allows only one stream connection per account.

parameter.name: mirrorToBroker
parameter.label: Mirror to Local Broker
parameter.description: Republish the direct stream to the local MQTT broker in the topic format of the bmw-mqtt-bridge, so that other tools can use it. Ignored in bridge mode.

parameter.name: mirrorRetain
parameter.label: Retain Mirrored Messages
parameter.description: Publish the mirrored stream messages retained, so that a consumer receives the last message of each vehicle when it connects, however old it is. Like MQTT_RETAIN of the bmw-mqtt-bridge. The connection state is always retained.

parameter.name: brokerHost
parameter.label: Broker Host
parameter.description: Host name or IP address of the local MQTT broker. Required in bridge mode and for mirroring.

parameter.name: brokerSecure
parameter.label: Use TLS
parameter.description: Connect to the broker with TLS. The certificate of the broker is verified with the trust store of the Java runtime.

parameter.name: topicPrefix
parameter.label: Topic Prefix
parameter.description: Prefix of the bridge topics, the LOCAL_PREFIX configured in the bridge.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Hours between refreshes of all vehicle data via the CarData API, one request per vehicle. 0 disables the periodic refresh; a vehicle is still read once when it goes online after its start or the start of the account, and after stream outages of five minutes or more.

parameter.name: requestBudget
parameter.label: Request Budget
parameter.description: Maximum number of CarData API requests the binding sends in 24 hours. BMW allows 50 requests per account and day; keep a reserve if other tools use the same account.
